# Overwatch 2 Freja Hero Trial - March 21, 2025

> 日期: 2025-03-19 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2025/03

## Introducing Freja

As head of Search and Rescue, Freja Skov dedicated her life to Overwatch and its mission of global peace. With the agency’s resources, there was no one Freja couldn’t find, no victim beyond her reach. But when Overwatch disbanded, Freja found herself adrift, purposeless... until she found a new market for her talent. As a bounty hunter, Freja attracted a different kind of clientele, one that showed her the true value of her skills. Now through March 24, get hands-on with her powerful crossbow, explosive bolts, and game-changing Ultimate. With a dynamic, strategy-driven kit, she’s built for players who thrive on precision and positioning—and she never misses her mark.

### Freja

- Damage Role
- Not available in Competitive Play during the Hero Trial

#### Revdraw Crossbow
- Primary Fire.
- Rapidly fire automatic bolts.

#### Take Aim
- Secondary Fire.
- Slow your momentum to take aim with a high-speed explosive bolt. Using Quick Dash refreshes Take Aim.

#### Quick Dash
- Ability 1.
- Vault in the direction you're moving and refresh Take Aim.

#### Updraft
- Ability 2.
- Launch upward with a gust of wind.

#### Bola Shot
- Ultimate ability.
- Fire an explosive bola. Hitting an enemy wraps them up and pulls in other nearby enemies.

#### Bounty Hunting
- Passive ability.
- Every 3 Final Blows, gain bonus ultimate charge.

#### Frost Bolts
- Minor Perk.
- Enemies hit by 3 regular bolts in quick succession are slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.

#### Tracking Instinct
- Minor Perk.
- Critical health enemies are revealed to you.

#### Ready to Hunt
- Major Perk.
- Updraft grants a temporary free use of Quick Dash.

#### Relentless Barrage
- Major Perk.
- Direct hits with Take Aim refund 4 automatic bolt ammo.
